name: Netanel (David's brother)
title: Jesse's fourth son
summary: Netanel was the fourth son of Jesse from Bethlehem and thus one of King David's older brothers. He was among the seven brothers whom Samuel saw when he came to anoint the new king over Israel, but the Lord had not chosen him.

keyEvents.title: Samuel examines Jesse's sons
keyEvents.description: When the prophet Samuel came to Bethlehem to anoint a new king, Jesse had his sons come before the prophet. Netanel was among the brothers who passed by, but the Lord had not chosen him.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Nethanel is recorded as the fourth of Jesse's sons in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in Chronicles.
